changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 5 item 7: moved channel/conversation-projection.ts to service/dispatcher-core-events/conversation-projection.ts and channel/core-port.ts to service/channel-service/core-port.ts. The first move closes a named inversion (channel/, the foundation tier, importing service-tier types DispatcherCoreEventPublisher and AgentEntityIdentity); the second is an ownership move onto channel-service/'s existing dependency-cruiser tier, with its one consumer unchanged. channel/ now holds only catalog.ts and external-channel-provider.ts. Updated all nine service/ importers plus input-source-lifecycle.ts's core-port.js import to the new paths; content unchanged beyond each file's own relative imports.
